conflicts.summary: Google's current What's New page says Computer Use is both supported and not supported; later repeated operator sources support Supported (Preview).
API sources say stable/GA while Google DeepMind's model showcase says Preview; API lifecycle is high-confidence, cross-surface status unresolved.
The model card's overall safety-outperformance summary sits against disclosed -3.9% text and -2.6% multilingual safety deltas, partly answered by an undisclosed manual-review breakdown.
The launch post's inner-reasoning claim links to Gemini 2.5 Flash cyber input-monitoring probes, not target-matched causal mechanism evidence for Gemini 3.5 Flash.

purpose: Adopted Part 3 source ledger for the public Gemini 3.5 Flash assessment record.
